baseline.description: Exact accepted release binaries preserved after grouped union reference work and before the inference coordinate-boundary migration.

semantic_evidence.red_reproduction: A recursive architecture test failed because inference/completion.rs and inference/type_query.rs imported tower-lsp protocol coordinates directly.
semantic_evidence.accepted_boundary: ruby-analysis inference accepts SourceFileId, TextRange, and UTF-8 byte offsets. The root completion adapter converts the current LSP UTF-16 position through RubyDocument exactly once. A recursive source-boundary test rejects tower-lsp and lsp-types dependencies anywhere under crates/ruby-analysis/src/inference.
semantic_evidence.utf16_regression: Completion after a non-BMP prefix resolves the same source-ordered local receiver and offers String#upcase. The old fallback treated the UTF-16 character count as a UTF-8 slice boundary.
semantic_evidence.scope_limit: This slice removes editor protocol types from the inference subtree only. Legacy ruby-analysis indexer, RubyDocument, document-symbol, and YARD surfaces still use tower-lsp and keep the complete library/CLI boundary open.
semantic_evidence.scorecard: 85/85 reviewed cases, 100/100 points, revision m0-seed-22, score_eligible=false, claim_eligible=false
semantic_evidence.workspace_tests: cargo fmt --all -- --check, git diff --check, cargo check --workspace, and cargo test --workspace exited 0; every extension, integration, black-box, and doc-test target passed
semantic_evidence.workspace_retry_note: The first maximum-concurrency workspace run hit the existing Standard fixer timeout and runtime-version probe timing flakes. Both passed individually; an immediate full maximum-concurrency repeat passed all targets.
semantic_evidence.cli_result: All five fresh final-release processes produced byte-identical valid JSON and the expected diagnostic exit status.

performance.measurement_note: The 100-iteration completion movement was 0.002542 ms and reversed to -0.000208 ms at 500 iterations. The changed completion path is therefore evaluated from the higher-confidence run. Hover and diagnostics are unchanged by this slice; their 500-iteration movements are 0.001291 ms and 0.000166 ms at the timer floor, and every process passed its fixed production budget.
performance.decision: Accepted. Large-file end-to-end and visitor medians are flat within 0.25 percent. The higher-confidence completion p95, edit p95, cold indexing, and references measurements improve; retained engine heap is byte-identical and all production budgets pass.

known_follow_ups: The scorecard remains deliberately claim-ineligible despite its seed-corpus score.
Protocol types still exist outside the inference subtree in ruby-analysis indexer, document, and YARD surfaces.
The goal-wide real-project diagnostic review and cold/warm/allocation/scheduling/two-project RSS matrix remain open.
Other unsupported Ruby expression and flow forms must continue to report explained Unknown until a complete static proof is implemented.
